department: Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology (College of Science)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1; there is no rolling deadline.
deadline.quote: The Chemistry PhD program does not have a rolling deadline; priority will be given to all materials submitted by the December 1 deadline.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required.
gre_general.quote: Chemistry: GRE General Test NOT required

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive a full tuition scholarship, a stipend-paying graduate assistantship and health insurance for the duration of the program.
funding.quote: For the duration of their program, students receive full tuition scholarship, a graduate assistant position with stipend, and health insurance.

english_waiver.value: A degree earned or in progress at an institution where English is the only medium of instruction counts as proof of English proficiency in the College of Science.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of English Proficiency is required for all applicants and for all programs (from one of the following): | Degree earned or in progress at an institution where English is the only medium of instruction

entry_route.value: Open to applicants with a bachelor's or a master's degree in chemistry or a related area.
entry_route.quote: designed for students who have earned a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in chemistry or related areas

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked so far
